title: Beneath the Cross (Getty)
lyrics_original: I find a place to stand,
That calls me as I am.
For hands that should discard me
Hold wounds which tell me come.
The ones that You have loved?
See the children called by God.
How great the joy before us
We will gladly live our lives.

bible_verses.english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
who himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the grace that invites me to stand beneath Your cross today. I am humbled by Your wounded hands, which held nothing back to win my unworthy heart. Thank You for welcoming me as I am and gathering me into Your forever family. Help me to rest in Your unconditional love and live every day in the freedom of Your mercy. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Standing beneath the cross of Jesus, we are confronted with a love that sees us as we truly are and still bids us to come. Where the world might discard us for our failures, Christ opens His wounded hands in eternal welcome. This sacred ground is where our unworthiness is met by overwhelming grace, transforming us from lonely wanderers into beloved members of God's family. As you sing today, rest deeply in the assurance that you belong at the feet of your Savior.
